why: The slot index inside the component runtime that `rust:RegisteredNode` witnesses. Same reasoning as that row. Until 2026-10-11 this row carried a pasted copy of `rust:NodeHandle`'s text ("Four node-shaped things", issue 0784), which described the facade's node types, not this name. phase-483 W2–W4 settled that: `nros::Node` is the one node type, the component trait is `nros::Component`, and `NodeHandle` / `StandaloneNode` left `nros::`.
